claim_inflight_items: claim a list of item UIDs atomically using the InflightRegistry to prevent duplicate processing across workers
release_inflight_items: release claimed item UIDs from the InflightRegistry after processing completes or fails
wait_for_inflight_items: block until in-flight items are no longer being processed by other workers or dead workers
inflight_session_context: use the inflight_session context manager to wait, claim, and auto-release cache items safely
record_worker_info: stamp a submitit job worker info onto claimed item UIDs in the InflightRegistry
